ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize baggage sorting, fueling records, and schedules, but people still have to stop anyone from approaching an aircraft before it is secure on the ramp.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 28,000 Aircraft Service Attendants employed in 2024, rising to a projected 29,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 1,500 jobs and about 4,300 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $41,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Aircraft Service Attendants, but it will remove some repetitive work. Automated baggage sorting, fueling data capture, and intelligent scheduling are becoming common. Ramp service centers on performing and checking work on site. Aircraft do not fuel or inspect themselves, so people still have to complete these tasks.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent deicing decision systems calculate needs from weather data
Ramp safety cameras assist with violation alerts
Special-purpose vehicle dispatch systems optimize work routes
Remote equipment diagnosis and preventive maintenance
ai_s2_auto: Automated baggage sorting and barcode tracking
Automatic recording of fueling data and flight information
ai_s3_list: Ramp safety inspection: complete every walkaround and procedural step.
Emergency response: handle fuel leaks and equipment failures on site.
Multitasking: monitor several aircraft during peak waves.
Ground communication: turn dispatch instructions into action over the radio.
Fitness and stamina: essential for long hours outdoors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means automation primarily affects process tasks such as recording, sorting, and dispatch. People still perform physical work and visual inspections. As automated equipment expands, attendants who can operate it and troubleshoot failures become more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean standing still. Automated sorting and robotic cleaning already operate at some hub airports. Attendants who only rely on physical effort and refuse to learn new equipment will lose ground. Airports want people who can run automated systems and take over safely when those systems fail.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Education requirements are modest, making this a practical route for families seeking stable civil aviation work. Evaluate safety and qualification training before pay. Airport ground service has a clear advancement path, but rotating shifts require preparation.

Earn firm credentials such as special-equipment operator and deicing qualifications, and learn automated sorting and dispatch systems. Move toward team leader or safety supervisor roles rather than staying at one fixed stand.

People with forklift, special-purpose vehicle, warehousing, or logistics experience can transition smoothly. Ramp service values procedural discipline and stamina. In interviews, safety-awareness examples matter more than academic credentials.

For high-turnover roles, retain workers through transparent scheduling, thorough safety training, and clear advancement paths. Hiring people with mechanical operation and logistics backgrounds can cost less than training new graduates from the beginning.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Barcode sorting with less manual lifting
Real-time recording and verification of fuel quantity
Automatic deicing-fluid calculations from weather data
Alerts for unsafe aircraft approaches and boundary crossings

ai_s7_trends: Automated baggage sorting and robotic cleaning are expanding at hub airports, reducing purely manual handling roles.
Ramp service is shifting toward equipment operation and safety oversight, increasing demand for certified workers with combined skills.
Airport expansion and recovering civil aviation passenger traffic keep overall demand for ground service roles stable.

body: Aircraft Service Attendants provide flight ground support at airports, including fueling, potable water and waste service, cabin cleaning and supply restocking, baggage handling, aircraft marshalling, and deicing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能替你把行李分拣、加油记录和排班算得明明白白，但机坪上「飞机还没停稳就有人靠上去」这种事，还得人来把关、人来喊停。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年飞机服务服务员在岗约 2.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.95 万人，净增约 0.15 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代飞机服务服务员，但会替他们干掉一部分重复活：行李自动分拣、加油数据自动记录、智能排班正在普及。机坪勤务的核心是「在现场干活、在现场把关」，飞机不会自己加油，更不会自己检查自己，这些环节还是需要人来完成。
ai_s2_accel: 智能除冰决策系统按气象数据自动测算
机坪安全监控摄像头辅助违规告警
特种车辆调度系统优化作业路径
设备故障的远程诊断与预防性维护
ai_s2_auto: 行李自动分拣与扫码追踪
加油数据与航班信息的自动记录
排班与勤务调度的智能化
客舱清洁机器人的定点作业
ai_s3_list: 机坪安全检查：绕机检查和程序执行一步不落。
应急处置：加油渗漏、设备故障下的临场处理。
多任务协调：波次高峰同时盯住几架飞机。
地面沟通：用对讲机把调度指令落到位。
体能与耐力：长时间户外作业的硬条件。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的自动化主要发生在「记录、分拣、调度」这些流程层，真正干活的手和检查的眼睛还在人身上；自动化设备越多，能操作设备、会排查设备异常的人反而越值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于原地踏步：自动分拣和机器人清洁已经在部分枢纽机场落地，只会蛮干、不学新设备的勤务员会被边缘化；能把自动化设备用顺、还能在它失灵时接住局面的，才是机场想要的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，适合把民航当成稳定出路的家庭。入职先看安全和资质培训，别只看工资；机场地服晋升路径清晰，但要做好倒班和心理准备。
把特种设备操作证、除冰资质这类硬证考下来，主动学自动分拣和调度系统。往班组长、安全监督方向走，别只守着一个固定机位。
有叉车、特种车辆、仓储物流经验的人转行最顺，机坪勤务看重的是守规矩和能吃苦。面试时强调你的安全意识案例，比强调学历有用。
流动率高的岗位，用「班次安排透明 + 安全培训到位 + 晋升通道明确」留人。多招有机械操作和物流背景的人，比招应届生从头教更省成本。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 扫码分拣、减少人工搬运
加油量实时记录与核对
按气象数据自动测算除冰液
违规靠机与越界行为告警

ai_s7_trends: 行李自动分拣与机器人清洁在枢纽机场推广，纯搬运岗减少。
机坪勤务向「设备操作 + 安全监督」转型，持证复合工更吃香。
机场扩建与民航客流恢复带动地面勤务岗位总量维持稳定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: OCR and RPA can read invoices into systems and reconcile transactions automatically, but clerks still identify anomalies, classify accounts, and verify compliant record retention.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,613,400 bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,519,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 94,300 jobs, with approximately 170,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks, but it will accelerate data entry and reconciliation. OCR, RPA, and centralized finance platforms speed up document recognition, posting, and reconciliation, shifting clerks from entering data toward investigating anomalies, applying consistent accounting policies, and maintaining compliant records. Data entry is accelerated most; people who find errors and understand compliance become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted anomaly flags
Faster account-classification recommendations
Automatic organization of audit working papers
Faster report-data retrieval
ai_s3_list: Anomaly investigation: people identify the incorrect transaction.
Consistent accounting treatment: people decide how to classify items.
Compliant retention: people verify that documentation is complete.
Complex judgment: people handle unusual transactions.
Accountability: people remain responsible for errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI-exposure range for data entry. Systems accelerate basic bookkeeping, while investigation and compliance remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Entering data and reconciling transactions are being replaced, not anomaly investigation and compliance work. People who find errors and understand compliance become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those limited to entering vouchers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through secondary vocational school or an associate degree in accounting, and develop systems skills and certifications while studying. Pure data-entry roles are shrinking in the AI era, so build investigation and compliance skills early.
Advance from entering vouchers to investigating anomalies and ensuring compliance. Learn centralized finance platforms and work toward general-ledger or audit roles.
Emphasize certifications and actual transaction volumes, and identify the systems you have used. Employers value accuracy and consistency.
Do not select candidates only for speed; assess how accurately they find errors. People who protect compliance are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Financial automation improves efficiency and reduces data entry.
Small and medium-sized businesses still need people.
People who find errors and maintain compliance are in greater demand.

body: Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks record daily income and expenses, reconcile vouchers and bank transactions, maintain general and subsidiary ledgers, and assist with reports and audit materials. They provide the foundation for business finance operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: OCR 和 RPA 能自动把发票读进系统、把流水对平，但哪笔异常、科目怎么归、留存合不合规，还是文员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年簿记、会计与审计文员在岗约 161.34 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 151.91 万人，岗位净减约 9.43 万个，年均产生约 17.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代簿记文员，但会加速录入与对账。OCR、RPA 和财务中台把凭证识别、记账、对账提速，文员从「录数据」挪向「异常核查、口径一致、合规留存」。真正被提速的是录入，能查错会合规的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助异常标
科目推荐提速
底稿自动整理
报表取数加速
ai_s2_auto: 发票 OCR 自动识别
ai_s3_list: 异常核查：哪笔不对靠人。
口径一致：怎么归靠人。
合规留存：票齐不齐靠人。
疑难判断：特殊业务靠人。
责任把关：错谁担靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的录入区——基础记账被系统加速，但核查与合规还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录数据、对流水」的动作，不是「查异常、守合规」的岗位。有查错力和合规意识的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会录凭证的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财会类中专大专打底，在校多练系统和证书。AI 时代纯录入在缩，早点练核查和合规。
从「录凭证」升级成「查异常 + 守合规」，学财务中台，争取转总账或审计。
突出证书和真实账务处理量，写清跟过哪些系统。雇主看重细和稳。
选人别只看手快，要看查错准不准。能守合规的，值得留用。

ai_s7_trends: 财务自动化提效，录入缩。
中小企业仍要人。
会查错守合规的更抢手。

body: 簿记、会计与审计文员记录日常收支，核对凭证与银行流水，维护总账与明细账，协助编制报表与审计资料，是企业财务运转的基础岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: OCR 和 RPA 能自动把发票读进系统、把流水对平，但哪笔异常、科目怎么归、留存合不合规，还是文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate which routes need more frequent service, but a driver still controls how one bus full of people gets home safely during evening rush hour.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 158,800 transit and intercity bus drivers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 165,600 by 2034, a net gain of about 6,800 jobs, with approximately 20,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $57,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate Bus Drivers, Transit And Intercity, but it will shift the role from repetitive driving toward safety oversight, service, and basic vehicle care. Automatic emergency braking and driver assistance already provide safeguards, while intelligent dispatch reorganizes schedules. As long as roads include pedestrians, construction, and unexpected events, the driver's seat needs someone who can decide instantly.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic emergency braking (AEB) and lane-departure warnings
Passenger-flow forecasts that drive dynamic departure intervals
Real-time monitoring for driver fatigue and distraction
Automated charging and energy-optimized dispatch for battery-electric buses
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent dispatch and automated scheduling, with systems calculating route frequency
Automated settlement of card and QR-code fares, replacing manual fare statistics
Digital driving records and route playback with automatically generated logs
Automatic vehicle fault-code reporting and systematic maintenance work orders
ai_s3_list: Emergency response: stabilize the situation when a passenger faints, a dispute starts, or an accident blocks the road.
Complex-road judgment: human anticipation remains essential for hidden pedestrians, aggressive merging, and flooded roads.
Passenger service and communication: people carry luggage for older riders and calm emotions.
Safety responsibility: algorithms cannot bear accountability for dozens of lives.
Physical and emotional management: sustain performance through prolonged sitting, congestion, and complaint pressure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means road driving remains the core of this occupation. It depends heavily on real-time judgment, so AI assists instead of taking control. Automation targets surrounding processes such as scheduling, fares, and logs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. As driver assistance spreads, operators prefer drivers who use intelligent equipment and understand basic vehicle care. Space gradually narrows for people relying only on traditional driving experience. The greater risk is refusing new tools, not the disappearance of the occupation.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Earn the required license and choose a transit operator with formal training. Learn intelligent equipment and basic vehicle care, building a combined role across driving, safety, and service.

Master driver-assistance and intelligent-dispatch terminals and maintain an accident-free record. Safety history is your strongest bargaining asset. Pursue advanced driving, dispatch, or safety roles to avoid a single-skill path.
Do not list driving tenure alone. Specify safe mileage, incidents handled, and familiarity with intelligent-dispatch terminals. Transit systems suit people seeking stability who handle pressure well.
Hire for safety records and emotional stability, not driving tenure alone. Retain drivers willing to learn intelligent equipment through stronger safety bonuses.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Dynamic departure intervals and real-time rerouting
Forward-collision warning and automatic emergency braking
Stop-level passenger-flow forecasting and schedule optimization
Automated stop announcements and broadcast prompts

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent dispatch and passenger-flow forecasting become standard, shifting drivers from fixed schedules to data-guided operations.
Driver assistance continues to spread, making human-machine coordination and equipment-operation skills more important.
An aging workforce expands driver shortages, increasing bargaining power for safe drivers who use intelligent equipment.

body: Bus Drivers, Transit And Intercity operate city buses on fixed routes. They depart on schedule, drive safely, operate doors, manage passenger flow, and respond to incidents as the last-mile operators of urban public transit.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出哪条线路该加密班次，但晚高峰一辆车、一车人怎么安全开回家，还得看司机手里的方向盘。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公交司机、公交在岗约 15.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.56 万人，净增约 0.68 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让公交司机整体消失，但会把它从「重复驾驶」往「安全值守 + 服务 + 机务」方向推。自动紧急制动、辅助驾驶已经在帮司机兜底，智能调度在重排班表，可只要路上还有行人、有修路、有突发，驾驶位就需要一个能瞬间拍板的人。
ai_s2_accel: 自动紧急制动（AEB）与车道偏离预警辅助驾驶
客流量预测驱动动态发车间隔
驾驶行为监测（疲劳、分心）实时提醒
纯电动公交的自动充电与能耗优化调度
ai_s2_auto: 智能调度与自动排班，线路班次由系统计算
刷卡、扫码票务自动结算，取代人工票务统计
行车记录、轨迹回放电子化，日志自动生成
车辆故障码自动上报，维保工单系统化
ai_s3_list: 突发处置：乘客晕倒、车厢争吵、前方事故，第一时间稳住局面。
复杂路况判断：鬼探头、加塞、雨天积水，机器预警代替不了人的预判。
乘客服务与沟通：帮老人抬行李、安抚情绪，人与人打交道机器做不来。
安全责任心：一车几十条命的底线意识，不是算法能背的锅。
身体与情绪管理：久坐、堵车、投诉压力下的长期稳定发挥。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的主体是「路面驾驶」——高度依赖实时判断的环节，AI 只能辅助不能接管；被自动化的是排班、票务、日志这些周边流程活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不代表没变化：辅助驾驶普及后，「会操作智能设备、懂简单机务」的司机会更吃香，纯靠老本行开车的空间会被慢慢压缩。真正该担心的是不会用新设备的守旧派，而不是整个职业。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行先把驾驶证考到位，选有正规培训体系的公交公司。AI 时代建议顺带学点智能设备操作和基础机务，往「驾驶 + 安全员 + 服务」复合方向走。
把辅助驾驶、智能调度终端玩熟，保持零事故记录——安全记录就是你最大的议价资本。有条件考个高级驾驶或转调度、安全员岗位，避开纯驾驶的单一赛道。
别只写「十年驾龄」，要写清楚你的安全里程、处理过什么突发、对智能调度终端的熟悉度。想稳定、抗压能力强的人，公交系统值得考虑。
招人别只看驾龄，要看安全记录和情绪稳定性。愿意培训智能设备的司机，值得用更高的安全奖留住。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 动态发车间隔、实时改线
前碰预警、自动紧急制动
站点客流预测、班次优化

ai_s7_trends: 智能调度与客流预测成为标配，司机从「按表跑」变成「按数据跑」。
辅助驾驶持续普及，驾驶位越来越依赖人机配合与设备操作能力。
老龄化背景下公交司机缺口扩大，安全记录好、会操作智能设备的司机议价能力上升。

body: 公交司机驾驶城市公交客车沿固定线路运营，负责按班次准点发车、安全驾驶、开关车门、客流组织与突发事件处置，是城市公共交通系统的最后一公里执行者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate certificates and compare data in batches, but diagnosing why an instrument is out of tolerance and whether it can be repaired still requires someone with hands-on instrument experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,800 Calibration Technologists And Technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 16,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 700 jobs, with approximately 1,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $65,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Calibration Technologists And Technicians, but it will reshape their work. Automated verification stations are taking over repetitive verification, while AI interprets data and drafts certificates. People still make the final decisions when operating reference standards, diagnosing anomalies, making on-site adjustments and repairs, and safeguarding measurement traceability. The job will involve less manual execution and more judgment.
ai_s2_accel: Batch calibration of common instruments on fully automated verification stations
Automated measurement-uncertainty evaluation tools
Digital certificates and online traceability platforms
AI-assisted analysis of out-of-tolerance causes and adjustment recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Metrology information searches and procedure comparisons
ai_s3_list: Reference-standard operation: handle and maintain precision equipment.
Out-of-tolerance judgment: locate error sources and reach a conclusion.
Adjustment and repair: address mechanical and electronic faults.
Uncertainty evaluation: quantify measurement error clearly.
Customer communication: explain certificates and traceability chains.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means calibration is a technical occupation with substantial digital exposure. Data collection, interpretation, and certificate generation are highly digital and offer significant automation potential, but people still provide the backstop for reference-standard operation, on-site judgment, and adjustment and repair.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure calls for an active shift. Move beyond repetitive manual caliper calibration toward advanced instruments such as coordinate measuring machines and laser interferometers, automated verification systems, and metrology management. As AI improves, your judgment becomes more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Metrology or measurement and control is the direct field of study, but an associate degree is enough to enter, so graduate school need not be the only focus. Gain practical experience and master measurement uncertainty during college.

Move quickly from purely manual verification to automated verification stations + advanced instruments, and earn registered metrologist certification. Learn data analysis proactively and improve certificate throughput to become indispensable to the team.

People with science or engineering backgrounds can transition into the field. Start as a calibration assistant or verification technician, master common measuring instruments and procedures, then pursue Class II registered metrologist certification. In interviews, emphasize attention to detail, tool proficiency, and data literacy.

The calibration industry does not simply lack people; it lacks people who understand automation. Introduce automated verification equipment to free employees from repetitive work, and provide certification subsidies to retain qualified talent.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid retrieval of procedures and standards

ai_s7_trends: As automated verification stations and digital certificates spread, purely manual calibration jobs are decreasing.
Demand for advanced metrology continues to grow in healthcare, new energy, and aerospace.
Calibration technicians are shifting from hands-on execution toward data judgment and metrology management.

body: Calibration Technologists And Technicians verify, calibrate, and adjust measuring instruments and equipment according to metrology standards and procedures. They record data, evaluate uncertainty, and issue certificates to ensure measurements are accurate and reliable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate certificates and compare data in batches, but diagnosing why an instrument is out of tolerance and whether it can be repaired still requires someone with hands-on instrument experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动出证书、批量比对数据，但「这台仪器为什么超差、能不能修好」这种判断，还得靠摸过仪器的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年校准技术员在岗约 1.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.65 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.14 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代校准技术员，但会改写干活方式：重复性检定正在被自动检定台接管，AI 能自动判读数据、生成证书草稿；而标准器操作、异常诊断、现场调修和量值溯源的把关，依然需要人来做最终决定。校准员会从「动手多」变成「判断多」。
ai_s2_accel: 全自动检定台批量校准普通仪表
测量不确定度自动评定工具
数字证书与在线溯源平台
AI 辅助超差原因分析与调修建议
ai_s2_auto: 校准数据自动采集与判读
校准证书模板自动生成
标准器台账与期间核查提醒
计量信息检索与规程比对
ai_s3_list: 标准器操作：精密设备的装卸与维护。
超差判断：定位误差来源并给出结论。
调修能力：机械与电子故障的处理。
不确定度评定：把测量误差算明白。
客户沟通：解释证书与溯源链路。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明校准是「中高曝光」的技术岗位：数据采集、判读、出证这些环节高度数字化，自动化空间大，但标准器操作、现场判断和调修仍要人来兜底。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着要主动换姿势：别再死磕手动卡尺校准这种活，往高端仪器（坐标测量机、激光干涉仪）、自动化检定系统、计量管理方向走，AI 越强，你的判断越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 报计量、测控类专业是正路，但大专学历就够入门，别只盯着考研。大学期间多动手、把测量不确定度这门课学扎实，比什么都强。
尽快从「纯手动检定」往「自动检定台 + 高端仪器」转型，考注册计量师；主动学数据分析，把出证效率做上去，你就是团队里不可替代的那个。
理工科背景可以转：先从校准助理或检定员做起，把常用计量器具和规程吃透，再考二级计量师。面试时强调心细、会用工具、能看懂数据。
校准行业缺的不是人，是「会自动化的人」。建议引入自动检定设备，把员工从重复劳动里解放出来，同时给考证补贴，留住持证人才。

ai_s7_trends: 自动检定台与数字化证书普及，纯手工校准岗位减少。
医疗、新能源、航空航天高端计量需求持续增长。
校准员从动手执行转向数据判断与计量管理。

body: 校准技术员与技师按照计量标准和规范，对测量仪器与设备执行检定、校准与调试，记录数据、评定不确定度并出具证书，保障量值准确可靠。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate course materials, grade assignments, and build question banks, but when a student connects the wrong wire in a workshop, a person must call out to disconnect the power first. AI cannot replace the instructor on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 122,200 Career/Technical Education Teachers, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 123,000 by 2034, a net gain of about 800 jobs, with approximately 8,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $61,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Career/Technical Education Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will take over substantial desk work. AI already assists courseware generation, question writing, grading, and learning analysis. The core of CTE is guiding students' hands, observing their mistakes, and protecting their safety. AI cannot perform or replace those on-site teaching tasks.
ai_s2_accel: Virtual-simulation training software expands instructional settings
Online learning platforms support blended instruction
AI teaching assistants answer common questions and reduce support workload
Digital twins of industry skills support instruction in new programs
ai_s2_auto: AI generation of courseware and teaching materials
Question-bank assembly and automated assignment grading
Automated schedules, equipment inventories, and administrative forms
ai_s3_list: Practical demonstration: teach students hands-on operation step by step.
Safety control: anticipate risks and stop unsafe actions in the workshop.
Individualized teaching: design learning paths for students with weak foundations.
Employment connections: match students with employer needs.
Skills-competition coaching: prepare students for provincial and national competitions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means automation concentrates in teaching documents. AI assists courseware, question banks, grading, and grade analysis, while practical instruction, student management, and employment guidance still require direct human involvement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk still brings change. Teachers who use AI for lesson preparation, question writing, and learning analysis can spend the time saved on students. Teachers who rely on old lesson plans and ignore new technology will fall behind as programs evolve.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose an occupation with genuine hands-on skills if you want to teach CTE. Automotive repair, electrical work, nursing, and intelligent manufacturing are all viable. Build strong practical skills during school and earn a teaching credential. Dual-qualified teachers have better employment prospects than theory-only instructors.

Use AI lesson-planning tools and invest the time saved in practical training and competitions. Track industry technology and move proactively into emerging programs such as new energy and robotics instead of protecting courses that are becoming obsolete. Plan dual-qualified status and professional-title advancement early.

Technical workers and engineers with industry experience gain an advantage when moving into CTE. Schools need people who understand industry. Complete a teaching credential and emphasize experience training new employees or apprentices during interviews.

Put industry practice and dual-qualified credentials ahead of academic degrees in hiring. Offer current teachers advanced training in new technologies and competition opportunities to retain core instructors who lead practical work and connect with industry.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Quickly generate courseware materials from the syllabus
Test assembly, grading, and result statistics
Integrated assignments, attendance, and learning analysis

ai_s7_trends: Virtual-simulation training is spreading and reducing hands-on training costs in high-risk programs.
Programs are updating faster with industry, creating clear instructor shortages in new energy and intelligent manufacturing.
Dual-qualified teachers are becoming standard, and instructors with industry backgrounds are more sought after.

body: Career/Technical Education Teachers, Postsecondary teach occupational skills at community colleges, vocational colleges, technical institutes, and related institutions. They teach practical subjects such as automotive repair, electrical work, nursing, and computing, organize hands-on training, and guide students into employment.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 12.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 12.30 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.88 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代职业教育教师，但会接管大量桌面工作：课件生成、题库出题、作业批改、学情分析都在被 AI 辅助。职业教育的核心是「带学生动手、看学生犯错、盯学生安全」，这些现场教学环节，AI 做不了也替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 虚拟仿真实训软件扩展教学场景
在线学习平台支持混合式教学
AI 助教回答常见问题减轻答疑压力
行业技能数字孪生辅助新专业教学
ai_s2_auto: 课件与教学素材的 AI 生成
题库组卷与作业自动批改
学情数据统计与成绩分析
课程表、设备台账与行政表单自动化
ai_s3_list: 实训示范：手把手教学生动手操作。
安全把控：实训现场的风险预判与喊停。
因材施教：给基础差的学生设计学习路径。
就业对接：把学生和企业需求撮合到一起。
技能竞赛辅导：带学生冲到省赛国赛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「教学文书」：课件、题库、批改、成绩分析都能被 AI 辅助，但实训教学、学生管理和就业指导是「人盯人」的活，AI 只能打下手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：会用 AI 备课、出题、做学情分析的老师，能把省下来的时间花在学生身上；只守着老教案、不跟进新技术的老师，在专业更新面前会被落下。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当职教老师，先选一个「真手艺」专业：汽修、电工、护理、智能制造都可以。读书期间把技能练硬，考下教师资格证，双师型老师比纯理论老师好就业得多。
把 AI 备课工具用起来，省下时间做实训和竞赛。盯紧行业技术变化，主动转型新专业（新能源、机器人），别守着要淘汰的课程。考双师型、评职称要提前规划。
有行业经验的技术工人、工程师转职教老师是加分项，学校很缺「懂产业」的人。补齐教师资格证，面试时多讲你带过新人、带过徒弟的经历。
招聘时把「行业实操经历」和「双师资质」放在学历前面；给在岗老师提供新技术进修和竞赛机会，留住能带实训、能对接产业的骨干。

高风险操作的安全模拟
实习岗位与就业信息匹配

ai_s7_trends: 虚拟仿真实训普及，高风险专业的实操训练成本下降。
专业随产业更新加快，新能源、智能制造师资缺口明显。
双师型教师成为标配，有产业背景的老师更吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Compensation and benefits managers, but it will reduce payroll calculation roles. HRIS and compensation cloud platforms automate payroll and tax calculations. Managers shift from building spreadsheets to designing systems, balancing fairness, making compliance judgments, and communicating with the business. Roles limited to calculations face the most pressure, while people who understand design and compliance become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent pay-band recommendations
Pay-adjustment simulations
Turnover cost forecasting
Benefits matching recommendations
ai_s3_list: System design: people define the structure.

Compliance judgment: people enforce the limits.

Sensitive decisions: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range. Systems accelerate calculations, while system design and compliance still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Technology replaces spreadsheet and payroll tasks, not the role of designing compensation systems. People who understand structure and protect compliance become scarcer as productivity rises. Specialists limited to calculations face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in human resources, finance, or statistics. Learn HRIS and data skills early. Pure calculation work is shrinking in the AI era, so build system-design skills.
Move from building spreadsheets to defining systems and protecting compliance. Learn benchmarking and cost analysis, then seek responsibility for the full compensation program.
Highlight project and compliance experience, including the industries you have worked in. Large employers value reliability and attention to detail.
Do not evaluate candidates on Excel alone. Look for system-design judgment. Core employees who can define compensation systems justify premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Calculations move to outsourcing; design stays in-house.
Data benchmarking becomes more common.
Managers with compliance expertise face stronger demand.

Funding-source matching

Stakeholder alignment: negotiation depends on people

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) does not publish a median for this detailed occupation because the estimate is suppressed. This page does not invent a figure (BLS OES, 2025). About 21,900 people worked in the occupation in 2024, and BLS projects -5% employment growth from 2024–2034 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fishing And Hunting Workers, but it will change how they find fish. Fish-finding sonar, satellite sea forecasts, and AI catch analysis now supplement experience and charts. Casting, hauling, and sorting on deck still require people. Machines can show where fish are, but they cannot cast and retrieve the net.
ai_s2_accel: AI fish prediction: model historical data to forecast fishing grounds
Smart gear monitoring: report net condition and catch in real time
Assisted vessel navigation: automated cruising and collision avoidance
Catch grading equipment: use image recognition to grade and sort automatically
ai_s2_auto: Fish-finding sonar: scan fish location and school size in real time

Catch-record app: automatically track catch volume and species

ai_s3_list: Sea and fishing-season judgment: experience determines when conditions are safe and where schools are located.
Hands-on gear skill: machines cannot replace the timing and teamwork required to cast and haul nets.
Deck coordination and safety: everyone works together during hauling, and rough seas leave no room for error.
Catch-handling experience: sorting, icing, and preservation directly affect sale price.
Risk judgment and respect: knowing when to stop and return to port saves lives.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 indicates relatively low AI exposure because most work occurs at sea and on deck. AI assists fish detection and sea forecasts, but people still cast, haul, and sort the catch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. AI makes fishing more precise and catch analysis more systematic. It reduces wasteful casting based on luck. Fishers who use sonar and forecasting tools and understand catch management work more efficiently and can earn more.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This career depends on vessel experience. Coastal fishery schools or maritime programs offer a starting point, and a crew certificate is mandatory. Focus on safety awareness and physical conditioning. Fishers who read sonar data and manage catches can earn more in the AI era, but consider the hardship and risk of life at sea.

Use fish detection and sea-forecast tools instead of relying only on instinct. Earn higher-level crew certificates and advance from deckhand toward captain or chief engineer for better income and safety protection.

Without experience, start in coastal aquaculture or as a vessel apprentice. Certification is key. Quantify voyage count, catch volume, and safety record on your resume. This work does not suit people who suffer severe seasickness or cannot tolerate hardship.

Do not hire on strength alone. Assess safety awareness and ability to learn technology. Crews need people who use sonar and forecasting tools, handle catches well, and tolerate life at sea. Profit sharing and stronger protections can improve retention.

Wind, wave, current, and weather data
Model historical data to forecast fishing grounds

Sonar, sea forecasts, and AI fish prediction are becoming standard vessel tools, shifting fishing from experience alone toward precise operations.
Fishers are moving from manual labor toward data-informed fishing operations, raising certification and skill requirements.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业绝大多数工作在海上、在甲板上——鱼群探测、海况预报这些桌面活正被 AI 辅助，但撒网、收网、分拣这些现场活，AI 还远不能替代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行靠跟船实践，沿海地区的渔业学校或海事类专业是起点，船员证书是硬门槛。重点是安全意识、体力培养。AI 时代，会看声呐数据、懂渔获管理的渔民收益更高，但海上辛苦和风险要想清楚。
把鱼群探测、海况预报工具用起来，别停留在「靠感觉找鱼」。考船员证书提升等级，从普通船员往船长、轮机长走，收入和安全保障都会上一个台阶。
无经验可从近海养殖或跟船学徒切入，考证是关键。简历上写「出海趟数、渔获量、安全记录」这类可量化成果。怕晕船、吃不了苦的人不建议尝试。
招人别只看体力，要看安全意识和技术学习能力。能配合声呐和预测工具、懂渔获处理、扛得住海上生活的船员，是船队最需要的，值得给分成加保障留住。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate which pipe sections are likely to clog, but only someone who has worked beside a manhole knows how to flush an old pipe today without bursting it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 30,400 septic tank servicers and sewer pipe cleaners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 32,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,300 jobs, with approximately 2,900 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $49,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace septic tank servicers and sewer pipe cleaners. On-site pumping, pipe cleaning, and blockage diagnosis require physical contact and equipment operation. No matter how intelligent the equipment becomes, someone must connect the hose and push tools into the pipe. AI can assist with dispatching, records, and data analysis, while the core work remains human.
ai_s2_accel: Pipeline inspection robots enter routine operations
Intelligent blockage-location prediction supports diagnosis
GPS and dispatch systems optimize service routes
Automated collection and reporting of environmental compliance data
ai_s2_auto: Automated work-order dispatch and route planning
Systematic equipment records and maintenance reminders
ai_s3_list: On-site judgment: identify blockages from water conditions and sounds.
Equipment operation: the hands-on feel of vacuum trucks and high-pressure cleaning.
Safe handling: control risks in confined-space work.
Adaptability: apply custom solutions to aging pipes.
Service communication: interact appropriately with residents and property managers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 describes a physically demanding service occupation with low AI exposure. The work depends heavily on on-site physical labor and actual equipment operation. AI currently assists only with dispatching, records, and data analysis; no system can replace the pumping and cleaning work itself.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean standing still. Pipeline inspection robots and intelligent dispatch are changing working methods. Crews that use these tools achieve higher efficiency, fewer accidents, and greater capacity to accept jobs.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This field has a low education threshold and is quick to enter, but the work is dirty and strenuous. People with strong hands-on ability and tolerance for hardship can apprentice at municipal or environmental service companies and earn credentials while working. Learning pipeline inspection technology also creates a path toward technician roles.

Advance toward technical work by learning to operate pipeline robots and inspection instruments and earning confined-space and other operating credentials. Moving from pure physical labor to technical operations improves both income and safety.

People without extensive formal education who need rapid employment can consider this field, but should first assess whether they can tolerate the environment. In interviews, emphasize driving experience, physical condition, and willingness to work hard. Relevant equipment-operation experience is an advantage.

Turnover is high, and base salary alone does not retain workers. A combination of piece-rate pay based on work volume + environmental allowances + safety training + a path to technician roles is more effective than simply increasing base pay.

ai_s7_trends: As pipeline inspection robots become widespread, cleaning shifts toward inspect first, then clean.
As environmental regulation tightens, standardized waste handling becomes a strict threshold.
Workers who operate intelligent inspection equipment transition into technician roles.

body: Septic tank servicers and sewer pipe cleaners pump septic tanks, clean and maintain drainage systems, and operate vacuum trucks, high-pressure cleaning equipment, and pipe-clearing tools to keep wastewater collection and discharge facilities operating properly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate which pipe sections are likely to clog, but only someone who has worked beside a manhole knows how to flush an old pipe today without bursting it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出哪段管道容易堵，但「这段老管子今天怎么冲才不爆」——只有蹲在井口干过的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年化粪池维修员下水管道清洁工在岗约 3.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.27 万人，净增约 0.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.91 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代化粪池维修员和下水道清洁工：现场抽吸、管道疏通、堵点排查都需要实际接触和操作，设备再智能也要有人到现场把软管接上、把机具推进管道里。AI 能帮的是派单、记录和数据分析，核心作业依然是人的活。
ai_s2_accel: 管道检测机器人进入常规作业
堵塞位置智能预判辅助排查
GPS 与调度系统优化作业路线
环保合规数据自动采集上报
ai_s2_auto: 工单派发与路线规划自动化
作业记录与报表电子化
设备台账与保养提醒系统化
客户预约与回访自动化
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：从水况与声音判断堵点。
设备操作：泵车与高压清洗的手感。
安全处置：有限空间作业的风险控制。
灵活应变：老旧管道的非标处理。
服务沟通：与住户、物业打交道的分寸。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行是「低 AI 曝光」的体力服务岗：作业高度依赖现场身体劳动和实际设备操作，AI 目前只能在调度、记录和数据分析层面帮忙，真正的抽吸疏通谁也替不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于原地踏步：管道检测机器人和智能调度正在改变作业方式，会用这些工具的班组效率更高、事故更少，接活能力也更强。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行学历门槛低、上手快，但确实脏累。如果孩子动手能力强、吃得了苦，可以先进市政或环保服务公司学徒，边干边考证。建议同时学点管道检测技术，往后往技术员方向走。
往技术化方向升级：学会操作管道机器人、检测仪器，考取有限空间作业等证照，从纯体力工转向技术作业员，收入和安全系数都更高。
没有学历包袱、需要快速就业的人可以考虑，但先想清楚自己受不受得了环境。面试时强调驾驶经验、体力状况和吃苦意愿，有相关设备操作经验更占优。
这行流动性高，靠基本工资留不住人。用「作业量计件 + 环境补贴 + 安全培训 + 晋升技术员通道」来留人，比单纯加底薪更有效。

ai_s7_trends: 管道检测机器人普及，疏通作业走向「先探后清」。
环保监管趋严，废弃物处置规范化成为硬门槛。
会操作智能检测设备的工人向技术员转型。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the tilt and layout of an entire roof in three minutes, but the project manager still needs to visit the site and check whether lifelines are attached and modules are securely installed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 921,600 installation managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 970,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 49,000 jobs, with approximately 74,400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $78,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace solar installation project managers, but it will automate the calculations. Tools can handle roof surveys, tilt design, production scheduling, and inspection reports. The core of project management, including site safety, workforce scheduling, grid coordination, and emergency response, still depends on people. As the solar industry grows and projects multiply, dependable site managers become scarcer.
ai_s2_accel: Drone-assisted inspections for quality acceptance
AI-based module defect detection improves efficiency
Digital construction platforms monitor progress in real time
Power-output forecasting supports plan decisions
ai_s2_auto: Automated roof surveys and tilt-plan generation
Automated construction scheduling and material planning
Automated generation of installation-inspection report templates
ai_s3_list: Site safety: control risks in work at height and electrical work.
Workforce scheduling: balance people, equipment, and materials under deadline pressure.
Multi-party coordination: align owners, utilities, designers, and suppliers.
Quality control: inspect concealed work and installation details.
Emergency response: handle weather, material shortages, and safety incidents in the moment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means that AI is deeply penetrating the technical side of solar installation management: surveys, design, scheduling, and inspection are becoming automated. Projects still succeed through on-site execution, where safety, coordination, and response require people, making managers more valuable as project volume rises.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure reflects a prosperous industry. AI makes each project faster and less expensive, and more projects make capable managers scarcer. Use digital construction tools and drones for acceptance while protecting the safety baseline, and the occupation's moat will deepen.

ai_s5_persona.建议: New energy offers strong long-term prospects, and electrical engineering, new energy science and engineering, and construction management all provide relevant preparation. Accept an entry stage involving fieldwork, sun exposure, and approvals before advancing into management. Earn electrician and other safety credentials as early as possible.

Master safety and grid-connection knowledge, earn relevant qualifications, and pursue large utility-scale plants and commercial and industrial projects. Use digital construction tools to manage projects and make strong project leadership part of your professional reputation.

People with backgrounds in power or construction management have an advantage when moving into solar management. Learn solar-system fundamentals, earn an electrician credential, and enter as a Construction Technician or Project Assistant. In interviews, emphasize projects managed and how you protected safety and schedules.

Solar projects are expanding rapidly and project managers are scarce. Retain talent through project bonuses + safety-credential training + advancement paths. During hiring, emphasize safety awareness and multi-party coordination rather than technical background alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated optimization of tilt and layout
Real-time visibility into progress and safety

ai_s7_trends: Continued growth in solar installations creates a long-term shortage of installation-management and grid-connection talent.
Digital construction sites and drone acceptance are becoming standard in project management.
Combined safety + grid connection + digital skills are becoming core thresholds for project managers.

body: Solar installation project managers organize on-site construction for solar projects, coordinating people, materials, equipment, and schedules. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安装经理在岗约 92.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 97.06 万人，净增约 4.90 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代光伏安装项目经理，但会把「算」的部分自动化：屋顶勘测、倾角设计、排产排程、巡检报告都能交给工具。项目管理的核心——现场安全、人员调度、并网协调、突发处置——依然靠人。光伏行业越发展，项目越多，靠谱的现场管理者就越缺。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机巡检辅助质量验收
AI 组件缺陷检测提效
数字工地平台实时监控进度
发电量预测辅助方案决策
ai_s2_auto: 屋顶勘测与倾角方案自动生成
施工排产与物料计划自动化
安装巡检报告模板自动生成
并网资料与台账电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场安全：高空与电气作业的风险管控。
人员调度：赶工期时把人、机、料配平。
多方协调：业主、电网、设计、供应商的拉扯。
质量把关：隐蔽工程与安装细节的验收。
突发处置：天气、缺料、安全事故的临场应对。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明光伏安装管理的「技术端」正被 AI 高度渗透：勘测、设计、排产、巡检都自动化了。但项目的本质是「在现场把事情办成」，安全、协调、应变这些环节 AI 帮不上忙，管理者的价值反而因项目增多而上升。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是行业繁荣的镜像：AI 让每个项目更快、更便宜，项目多了，会管项目的人就更稀缺。把数字化工地工具和无人机验收用起来，同时把安全底线守住，这行的护城河只会越挖越深。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 新能源是确定性很强的赛道，电气、新能源科学与工程、工程管理专业都对口。建议孩子先接受「跑现场、晒太阳、跑审批」的起步阶段，再逐步转向管理岗；电工证等安全资质越早考越好。
把安全和并网知识学透，考取相关资质证书，往大型地面电站和工商业项目方向走。同时用数字化工地工具管理项目，把「会管项目」变成你的个人品牌。
有电力、建筑工程管理背景的人转型光伏管理有优势。先补光伏系统知识，考电工证，从施工员或项目助理切入；面试时突出「管过什么工程、怎么保安全保工期」。
光伏项目扩张快，项目经理缺口大。建议用「项目奖金 + 安全资质培训 + 晋升通道」留人；招聘时重点考察安全意识和多方协调能力，别只看技术出身。

ai_s7_trends: 光伏装机持续增长，安装管理与并网人才缺口长期存在。
数字化工地与无人机验收成为项目管理标配。
「安全 + 并网 + 数字化」复合能力成为项目经理核心门槛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically generate differentiated lesson plans, but only the teacher kneeling in front of a child knows whether that child is willing to speak today.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 29,300 special education teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 29,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 2,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $62,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace special education teachers, but it will reduce desk-work burdens. AI can draft IEPs, assessment reports, and lesson plans, returning the saved time to students. What cannot be replaced is face-to-face demonstration, immediate judgment during behavioral interventions, and the patience required to build trust.
ai_s2_accel: Speech recognition and transcription support speech training
AI behavior observation tools support classroom behavior analysis
Intelligent upgrades to augmentative and alternative communication devices
Learning analytics platforms track individual mastery
ai_s2_auto: Draft generation for IEPs and assessment reports
Batch production of individualized lesson plans and teaching materials
Recording and charting student progress data
ai_s3_list: Immediate behavioral judgment and intervention: only a person on site can respond in the seconds before a child's emotional escalation.
Trust building: long-term support helps a withdrawn child become willing to learn with you.
Flexible individualized adjustment: lesson plans are references, and teachers must change approaches at any moment.
Family-school and team collaboration: people must reconcile parents' emotions with therapists' plans.
Emotional labor and professional resilience: maintain patience and hope during slow development over long periods.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means half of this occupation's work occurs at a desk. IEPs, lesson plans, and records are precisely the tasks AI currently performs best.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. When AI takes over desk work, teachers can focus more time on children. Documentation-focused teachers who can write materials but cannot teach will face pressure, while excellent teachers will become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: While studying special education, develop differentiated skills in behavioral intervention, speech training, and assistive technology. In the AI era, teachers who can teach + write IEPs + use technology are in greatest demand.
Use AI for IEP generation and data records and devote the saved time to instruction and communication. Continue training in inclusive education and resource-room operations to broaden your path.

First earn special education teaching credentials and start as a resource-room assistant or shadow teacher. Do not simply write that you are caring; specify which children you supported, which methods you used, and what progress resulted.

Do not recruit special education teachers based only on credentials; test on-site responses by asking how they would intervene in a specific scenario. Candidates who can write IEPs, use assistive technology, and remain emotionally stable deserve higher compensation.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Differentiated lesson plans and tiered practice

ai_s7_trends: Inclusive education becomes mainstream, moving special education teachers from specialized schools into resource rooms at general schools.
AI and assistive technology substantially reduce desk-work burdens, increasing the value of time spent teaching.
Specialized capabilities such as behavioral intervention and speech training become professional differentiators, and versatile special education talent commands a clear premium.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动生成差异化教案，但那个孩子今天愿不愿意开口，只有蹲在他面前的老师知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年特殊教育教师在岗约 2.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.97 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.22 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代特殊教育教师，但会把案头负担减下来。IEP 草稿、评估报告、教案初稿都能让 AI 代劳，教师把省下的时间还给学生。真正无法替代的，是面对面的示范、行为干预里的即时判断，和建立信任的那份耐心。
ai_s2_accel: 语音识别与转写辅助言语训练
AI 行为观察工具辅助课堂行为分析
辅助沟通设备的智能化升级
学习分析平台追踪个体掌握进度
ai_s2_auto: IEP 与评估报告的草稿生成
个别化教案与教学材料的批量产出
学生进步数据的记录与图表化
家校沟通邮件的草稿与整理
ai_s3_list: 即时行为判断与干预：孩子情绪要爆发的前几秒，只有现场的人能接住。
建立信任关系：让一个封闭的孩子愿意跟着你学，靠的是长期陪伴。
个别化的灵活调整：教案是参考，现场随时要换招。
家校与团队协作：家长的情绪、治疗师的方案，都需要人去熨平。
情绪劳动与职业韧性：长时间面对慢速成长，仍保持耐心和希望。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头——IEP、教案、记录，这些正是 AI 现在最会干的活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：案头工作被 AI 接管后，教师的时间反而更聚焦到孩子身上。被挤压的是只会写材料、不会教学的「文档型教师」，真正会教的人价值只会更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学特教专业的同时，把行为干预、言语训练、辅助技术作为差异化技能。AI 时代「会教 + 会写 IEP + 会用技术」的特教老师最抢手。
把 IEP 生成、数据记录交给 AI，把省下的时间用在教学和沟通上。进修融合教育、资源教室运营方向，路子更宽。
先考特教教师资格证，从资源教室助理或影子老师做起。别只写「有爱心」，要写你带过什么类型的孩子、用什么方法取得过什么进步。
招特教老师别只看证书，要考现场应对：给一个情境问你怎么干预。能写 IEP、会用辅助技术、情绪稳定的候选人，值得更高待遇。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 个体掌握度、数据可视化

ai_s7_trends: 融合教育成为主流，特教老师从特教学校走向普校资源教室。
AI 与辅助技术大幅降低案头负担，教学现场的时间更值钱。
行为干预、言语训练等专项技能成为职业分水岭，复合型特教人才溢价明显。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can calculate supply and demand, but specialists still decide how to allocate total resources, enforce limits, and coordinate agencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 104,300 water resource specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 108,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with approximately 8,500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $161,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace water resource specialists, but it will accelerate analysis. Remote sensing and models speed up monitoring and accounting, shifting specialists from calculations to total resource allocation, limit tradeoffs, cross-jurisdictional coordination, and planning implementation. People who only prepare reports will be squeezed out, while those who understand allocation and coordination will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Water shortage risk forecasting
Allocation scenario modeling
Intelligent efficiency diagnosis
Cross-jurisdictional coordination support
ai_s3_list: Total resource allocation: people decide the tradeoffs.
Regulatory limit tradeoffs: people exercise judgment.
Cross-jurisdictional coordination: people manage negotiations.
Planning implementation: people drive progress.
Accountability: people sign off on plans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure in management work. Systems accelerate monitoring and modeling, but people still handle allocation and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Calculations and reports are being replaced, not allocation and coordination roles. People who understand water accounts and can coordinate stakeholders become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only prepare spreadsheets face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with hydrology or environmental studies and learn modeling and GIS early. Pure reporting is shrinking in the AI era, so develop allocation skills.
Advance from calculations to setting allocations and coordinating stakeholders. Learn planning and policy, and seek responsibility for a region.
Highlight project and coordination experience and specify which watersheds you have supported. Water institutions value reliability and accuracy.
Do not hire based only on education. Assess whether candidates understand allocation. Core employees who can coordinate stakeholders deserve project responsibility.

ai_s7_trends: Monitoring and modeling accelerate.
Regulatory limit management becomes stricter.
People who understand allocation and coordination are in greater demand.

body: Water resource specialists assess, plan, and allocate regional water resources. They calculate supply-demand balances, establish water-use limits, and coordinate agencies to implement management objectives, serving as key advisors in water resource management.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年水资源专员在岗约 10.43 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.82 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代水资源专员，但会加速分析。遥感与模型把监测核算提速，专员从「算数」挪向「总量分配、红线权衡、跨域协调、规划落地」。真正被挤掉的是只做报表的人，懂配置与协调的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 短缺风险预测
配置方案推演
效率智能诊断
跨域协调辅助
ai_s3_list: 总量分配：取舍靠人定。
红线权衡：分寸靠人拿。
跨域协调：博弈靠人。
规划落地：推动靠人。
责任承担：方案靠人签。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的管理区——监测建模被系统加速，但分配与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算数报表」动作，不是「配置协调」的岗位。懂水账、能协调的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 水文/环境起步，早点学模型与 GIS，AI 时代纯报表在缩，练配置。
从「算数」升级成「定分配 + 协调」，学规划与政策，争取管区域。
突出项目与协调经验，写清跟过哪些流域。水务看重稳和准。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有配置脑子。能协调的骨干，值得给项目。

ai_s7_trends: 监测建模提速。
红线管理更严。
懂配置协调的更抢手。

body: 水资源专员评价、规划与配置区域水资源，核算供需平衡、划定用水红线并协调涉水部门落实管理目标，是水资源管理的核心参谋岗。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 模型能算供需，但总量怎么分、红线怎么守、部门怎么协调，还是专员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate monitoring, but people still decide the architecture, diagnose failures, and drive migrations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 472,000 web administrators were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 510,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 38,500 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 31,300 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $109,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace web administrators, but it will reduce routine operations. Automation absorbs deployment and monitoring, shifting administrators from entering commands toward defining architecture, diagnosing failures, driving migrations, and managing security. People limited to repetitive operations face the greatest pressure, while strong judgment becomes more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent fault localization
Intelligent capacity forecasting
Intelligent permission recommendations
Intelligent change assessment
ai_s3_list: Architecture judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Failure diagnosis: people find the root cause.
Migration execution: people coordinate the work.
Security governance: people define the boundaries.
Incident command: people make the decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI exposure is moderate. Routine operations are automated, but people retain judgment and emergency response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. Repetitive operations are being replaced, not the role of keeping sites stable. People with architecture skills become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with computer science and practice cloud and networking skills. Pure operations are shrinking in the AI era, so develop architecture ability early.
Advance from entering commands to defining architecture and managing security, and learn automation.
Highlight stability and security outcomes and clearly state the scale of systems you managed.
Do not hire solely for command-line knowledge. Assess the ability to diagnose failures and define architecture.

ai_s7_trends: Operations automation is widespread, shrinking routine work.
Demand for stability and security is rising.
People with architecture skills are in greater demand.

body: Web administrators deploy, monitor, and maintain websites and backend services, coordinate servers, domains, and permissions, and ensure stable, secure availability.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动监控，但架构怎么定、故障怎么判、迁移怎么推，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年网站管理员在岗约 47.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.05 万人，净增约 3.85 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 Web 管理员，但会压缩常规操作。运维自动化吃部署与监控，管理员从「敲命令」挪向「定架构、判故障、推迁移、管安全」。真正被挤掉的是只做重复操作的，有判断力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 故障智能定位
容量智能预测
权限智能推荐
变更智能评估
ai_s3_list: 架构判断：取舍靠人。
故障定位：根因靠人。
迁移推进：协调靠人。
安全治理：边界靠人。
应急指挥：决断靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光中等——常规操作被自动化，但判断与应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「重复运维」动作，不是「把站点稳住」的岗位。有架构力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 计算机起步多练云与网络，AI 时代纯操作在缩，早点练架构。
从「敲命令」升级成「定架构 + 管安全」，学自动化。
突出稳定与安全成果，写清管过哪些规模。
选人别只看会命令，要看会不会判故障、定架构。

ai_s7_trends: 运维自动化普及，常规缩。
稳定与安全需求升。
有架构力者更抢手。

body: Web 管理员部署、监控与维护网站及后台服务，统筹服务器、域名与权限，保障站点稳定与安全可用。
